notes.title: Demo v0.4 Update!
notes.content:
Hello, it's been a while!

[previewyoutube=ONDK-CnW2Co;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's a list of the latest demo updates on v0.4 which hopefully be the [b]final demo until the full release[/b] of the game:
[list]
[*] 	Controller Support
[*] 	Steam Deck Support
[*] 	UI Updates
[*] 	Player Movement Fixes
[*] 	Anomalypedia Fixes
[*] 	Gameplay QoL Improvements
[*] 	Improved Performance
[*] 	Updated 3D model textures
[*] 	New Lighting System
[*] 	Better Tutorial
[*] 	New Secret Content
[/list]

[b]
Why 0.4?[/b]
The game is about 40% done! Full Release is still TBA since it's still handled by one person (me), it's going to take a while to develop but the development is still going! I'd highly appreciate if you could wishlist & share the game with anyone who thinks this game is their cup of tea!

Full Release Details:
[list]
[*]     5 new levels that spans across all boroughs in New Noir!
[*]     120 anomalies to be discovered in the full game!
[*]     5 new camera filters to unlock!
[*]     New cases & characters to interact with!
[*]     New unannounced features!
[/list]

If you encounter any undocumented problems, please send a message to us with the subject (PROJECT ANOMALY - BUG REPORT: *Your bug*) to darksciencelabs@gmail.com which includes your specs to be for our future iterations of optimization. 

Also don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/DarkScienceLabs]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/darksciencelabs/]Instagram[/url] (@darksciencelabs).

Embrace the unknown, happy investigating!

DARK SCIENCE

notes.title: v0.35 - BUG FIXES & BACK IN DEVELOPMENT!
notes.content:
[h1]After a year of not being in development, we're back! Also we just released a new Demo update v0.35  for bug fixes and QoL improvements just now![/h1]
[h1]
[b]!!! If you already played the demo and want to try the latest changes, please start a new game or delete the save data !!![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42361197/188ab034a5d1b821883d18d70c50eaa5305c35b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42361197/6614aa49172ba2c7a548d0ded76966aa35e6b72d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42361197/bddc9315ec10b3bbe4833d68a91c6f17191fa81e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42361197/c5046aa2fbe86faaebb819e7f4e86fab85befe42.png[/img]

[h3]Bugs Fixed in v0.35:[/h3]
We heard all of your feedback and here are the things that we fixed:
[list]
[*] Missing Player Settings. Now added BGM Volume, SFX Volume, & Mouse Sensitivity
[*] Controls are slidey/slippery (change how the player transform is modified)
[*] Cases that require you to tame anomalies didn’t load properly when opening a save file
[*] Interacting with an object a few seconds before the shift ends will softlock the player
[*] Interacting with an object too quick can softlock the player as well
[*] Game doesn’t scale with monitors that are not 1600:900 & performance are highly reduced
[*] Hide PDA button & icon during a dialogue
[*] Loading a save file after quitting can’t load the unlocked filter anymore
[*] Filter can be reenabled during the camera on/off transitions
[/list]
 
[h3]Plans for the future:[/h3]
 Things that will be in development for the full game:
[list]
[*] Controller support
[*] 3D environment polishing
[*] 5 new levels which include new cases, characters, & anomalies
[*] 5 new camera filters
[/list]
 
Currently the game is just being developed in a part-time manner by just one person (me). If we got a lot of support or funding, the game will be developed faster with more consistent progress. If you are interested in being a programmer, 3D artist, or a technical artist, feel free to reach us out! :)

If you enjoyed the demo, wishlist & share the game demo with your friends if you haven't! It's hard to get attention where everyone only looks out for things that are already popular and we would highly appreciate your help!

Also don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/DarkScienceLabs]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/darksciencelabs/]Instagram[/url] (@darksciencelabs). 

Embrace the unknown, happy investigating!

DARK SCIENCE
